palette.notes: Frames: bright sky blue with big soft white clouds, rock faces shaded pink to purple, grass tops a hard bright green. Caves go deep maroon/plum with blue-grey stone; purple carries every shadow, green caps every ledge.

lighting: Ambient by area: open sky is high-key and airy, caves drop to dark plum with a few light shafts and moss highlights; the green grass rim is the brightest value indoors, so ledges read as lit edges.
silhouette: Otus is very small on screen (wide wingspan, cloak, round head) and still reads because he is warm brown against cool purple/blue walls. Enemies and allies are chunky, round blobs in that same small scale.

motion.timing: Not measured. Frames show Otus gliding with wings spread wide and a carried ally hanging below; flight is the default state, so he floats rather than lands.

texture: Painterly hand-placed clusters: clouds built from stacked rounded pixel clusters, brick-like stone walls in muted blue-grey, scraggly moss and hanging roots along every ceiling. Dense but low-contrast, so the small hero still pops.
camera: Wide, free-scrolling side view with lots of headroom; the character often takes under a tenth of the frame. Parallax layers and soft-focus foreground foliage frame the shot.

acting.enters: Flies in from the sky or drops into a cave chamber; the wide frame shows him arriving from far away.
acting.acts: Mute hero: acts with wing pose and posture. Fights happen small inside big rooms with an enemy cluster on the floor.
acting.exits: Flies up and out of frame into the next layer or chamber.
acting.depth: Blurred foreground foliage and sky layers sit in front of and behind the play plane; the hero lives small in the middle layer of a big world.

techniques: hue-shifted shadows: rock and cave shadows go purple, not black
bright green ledge caps as rim light that marks every walkable edge
warm hero on cool environment for readability at tiny size
painterly cloud clusters instead of dithered gradients
wide framing that keeps the hero tiny
feel: soft purple-shadowed world + bright green ledges + tiny warm hero gliding through = lush storybook adventure
for_fred: Put Fred tiny and warm-coloured in a wide cool scene, gliding across the background layer behind a blurred foreground, then cut him in big and close. Shadows on Fred and his scene go purple, not black.
